description: Buyer-authored pin to one exact immutable audience-evidence snapshot selected during discovery. Sellers MUST match all four fields against a single published snapshot; they MUST reject the package rather than substitute a newer version or reuse snapshot_id with changed content. A confirmed package MUST return the same identity in audience_evidence_selections with decision_use package_construction.

ext.description: Extension object for platform-specific, vendor-namespaced parameters. Extensions are always optional and must be namespaced under a vendor/platform key (e.g., ext.gam, ext.roku). Used for custom capabilities, partner-specific configuration, and features being proposed for standardization.
ext.title: Extension Object
